name: c02_cta_severe_wx
title: Whole Agadir CTA, severe squall line, everything at once
description: All four Agadir sectors band-boxed, near capacity. A severe squall line (tops FL450-500) stretches from Oceanic South across West South with three gaps. A Royal Moroccan Air Force C-130 (state aircraft, not RVSM approved) is southbound on UN857. Arrivals: GCRR via TERTO, GMMN via MARJA and SALCA (LoA FL250, 10 NM in trail).
design_notes: EZY39WK (northbound UN858, FL380) reports unable RVSM at T+11:40 and crosses DLH512 (RUNAX-IBALU-SAMAR, FL390) in West South at T+25:00. RMF4425 (C130 state aircraft, non-RVSM, FL250) asks FL290: allowed for a state aircraft, but it needs 2000 ft and BTI6JW at FL270 is ahead on UN857 - check who it climbs through. VIPER31 (4xF16, NIPRI-NIDEB-ROLRO at FL350) crosses NOZ5KX northbound on UN858 at FL340. GMMN arrivals: RAM761 and RAM213 reach SALCA 40 s apart; GCRR arrivals EXS59R and TOM88J reach TERTO 45 s apart; RAM767 at MARJA. The squall line forces deviations through three gaps across UN873, UN858, UN857 and the TERTO arrivals.
